messages:
Jess (docs): quick heads-up — nightly linkscan flagged ~26 internal links to /runbooks/ops/* that 404 after the slug rename. example: https://kb.redwood.ai/runbooks/ops/elastic-shutdown -> 404. anyone own runbooks/ops now?

LinkScanBot: automated scan: 26 broken links across 6 files. report: https://internal/reports/link-scan/9202222222

Kai P: I still own elastic-shutdown. I'll patch that page today.

Remi: I can do a repo-wide replace for the rest if we confirm the new prefix. What is the target? /runbooks/operational/ ?

Leila: migration doc says /runbooks/operational/ is canonical. I can temporarily restore aliases for any partner-facing URLs if needed, but prefer inbound fixes.

Jess (docs): plan: Kai handles his pages (elastic-shutdown + cache-flush), Remi does mass-fix PRs in small batches, Leila will re-add shortlinks only for external hits. I'll open an issue to track: https://github.com/redwood/docs/issues/421

Kai P: PR for elastic-shutdown: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/5020 — updates links + frontmatter. PTAL @Jess

CI-Bot: PR #5020 staging build succeeded: https://staging.kb.redwood.ai/pull/5020 :white_check_mark:

Remi: running sed pass now. I'll break into 5 PRs (~4 files each) and tag reviewers. First PR ETA ~25m. Command: rg "runbooks/ops/" -n | cut -d: -f1 | sort -u | xargs -n1 sed -i 's:/runbooks/ops/:/runbooks/operational/:g'

Jess (docs): thanks. checklist for PRs: update links, update canonical/frontmatter if present, add one-line changelog entry, and assign codeowner review. I'll watch the issue and merge when green.

Leila: once merged i'll run a smoke scan and then prune any temporary shortlinks we added. If partners report old URLs, we'll add ephemeral redirects and track them in the issue.

Jess (docs): perfect. ping here for blockers and i'll coordinate reviews. Closing thread when all PRs merged. :thumbsup:
